results.prompt: Hindi Billing: Do packet Amul butter aur teen litre doodh add karo
results.fullResponse:
Arey! Aap Amul butter aur doodh add karwana chahte hain, theek hai! 👍

Main aapki shop ka billing system toh nahi hoon, par main aapki madad kar sakta hoon stock aur sales track karne mein.

Aapne bola:
*   **2 packet Amul Butter** 🧈
*   **3 litre Doodh** 🥛

**Ek zaruri baat:** Aapke paas **Milk 1L ke sirf 3 packet hi bache hain**. Agar aap 3 litre bechte hain, toh aapka milk stock zero ho jaayega! 😱

**Meri salah:**
1.  Yeh sale record kar lijiye.
2.  **Jaldi se Milk 1L aur Amul Butter 100g order kar lijiye!** Aapka stock bahut kam hai.

Aur koi madad chahiye toh bataiye! 😊

results.prompt: Mixed Code-Switching: Ek kilo sugar add karo and two Maggi packets

Aapke paas abhi **Sugar 1kg ke 12 kg** bache hain. Agar aapko Maggi add karna hai, toh uska current stock kitna hai, main woh bhi check kar sakta hoon agar aapke paas Maggi ka data hota.

Kya aapko Sugar ya koi aur item restock karna hai, ya stock report dekhni hai? Bataiye! 👍

results.prompt: Aaj shaam ke liye doodh kitna mangwana chahiye?
results.fullResponse:
नमस्ते! 👋

Abhi aapke paas **Milk 1L ke sirf 3 packet** bache hain. 🥛 Yeh toh bahut kam hai, aur doodh toh top selling item hai!

Shaam ki rush aur kal subah ke liye, main kahunga ki aap **kam se kam 20-25 packet doodh** mangwa lo. Taaki koi customer wapas na jaaye aur stock ki kami na ho. 😊

results.prompt: Kaunsa saamaan bilkul nahi bik raha hai?
results.fullResponse:
नमस्ते! 👋

Abhi tak ke data ke hisaab se, **aaj aur is mahine koi bhi saamaan bikri nahi dikha raha hai**. 😟

Ho sakta hai ki abhi din ki shuruaat ho ya sales data update na hua ho. Fikar mat karo!

**Actionable tip:**
*   Apne customers ko yaad dila sakte ho ki aapke paas unke pasandida items available hain.
*   Jo items low stock mein hain, unhe pehle replenish kar lo, jaise **Milk, Amul Butter, Sugar, Fortune Oil, Aashirvaad Atta**. 📦
*   Shaam tak sales update ho jayegi, tab hum phir se check karenge! 😊

results.prompt: Diwali aane wali hai, stock mein kya change karoon?
results.fullResponse:
Namaste! 👋 Diwali aane wali hai, yeh toh customers ko khush karne ka best time hai! 🥳

**Stock mein yeh changes zaroor karo:**

1.  **Mithai aur Nashte ka Saamaan:**
    *   **Sugar 1kg (12 kg left)**: Diwali mein mithai banegi, toh isko khoob stock karo.
    *   **Amul Butter 100g (8 pc left)**: Butter bhi lagega, jaldi replenish karo.
    *   **Fortune Sunflower Oil 1L (4 bottle left)**: Talne ke liye oil ki demand badhegi, stock up!
    *   **Aashirvaad Atta 5kg (6 bag left)**: Log zyada khana banayenge, toh atta bhi extra rakho.
    *   **Naye items:** Besan, Maida, Ghee, aur Dry Fruits (Kaju, Badam, Kishmish) rakho. Inki demand bahut hoti hai.

2.  **Pooja Ka Saamaan:**
    *   Diyas, Agarbatti, Kapoor, Cotton Wicks, Moli, Ganga Jal – yeh sab customers zaroor lenge.

3.  **Gift Packs:**
    *   Chocolates aur Biscuits ke festive packs rakho. Log gifting ke liye lete hain.

Jaldi se yeh sab order karo taaki Diwali rush se pehle stock ready ho! All the best! ✨

results.prompt: Kal baarish hone wali hai, dukan par kya farak padega?
results.fullResponse:
नमस्ते! Kal baarish hai toh thoda farak toh padega, par hum isko bhi mauke mein badal sakte hain! 🌧️

**Kya farak padega aur kya karein:**

1.  **Kam Customers:** Baarish mein log kam nikalte hain. Isliye, zyada walk-in customers ki ummeed kam rakhna.
2.  **Home Delivery:** Agar aap home delivery karte hain toh ye best time hai! Apne customers ko batao ki aap delivery kar rahe ho.
3.  **Stock Check (Important!):** Log ghar baithe cheezein manga sakte hain ya baarish se pehle stock up kar sakte hain. Aapke paas **Milk (3 packet)**, **Sugar (12 kg)**, **Amul Butter (8 pc)**, **Fortune Oil (4 bottle)**, aur **Aashirvaad Atta (6 bag)** kam hain.
    *   Inko turant restock kar lo! Log chai, pakode, aur khana banane ke liye yeh sab zyada lenge.
    *   Tea, coffee, biscuits, aur snacks bhi check kar lo, inki demand badh jaati hai.
4.  **Dukaan Surakshit Rakhein:** Apne stock ko paani aur dampness se bachane ka intezam kar lo.

Baarish mein bhi aapki sales achhi ho sakti hain, bas thodi planning chahiye! 👍
